findings.description: Mozilla Firefox is prone to multiple vulnerabilities.
findings.impact:
Successful exploitation will allow
  attackers to run arbitrary code, cause denial of service and disclose
  sensitive information on affected systems.
findings.mitigation:
Upgrade to version 117 or later,
Please see the references for more information.
findings.title: Mozilla Firefox Security Update (mfsa_2023-32_2023-36) - Windows
